objective: separate strict fake-driver fixtures from honest real-hardware invariants in the complete global-dispatch and synthetic Activity gate

selection.scope: the Activity harness injects the environment variable into the global-dispatch client child only

unchanged_exact_values: sampled-image maximum 4096x2048, 12 mips, 256 layers, and 4 GiB resource size
image requirements2 size 19623936 and both dedicated-allocation booleans true

hardware_invariants.api: loader and physical-device API versions are at least Vulkan 1.0
hardware_invariants.identity: every proxy has the required typed high byte, is nonzero, and distinct objects remain distinct; serial values are not assumed
hardware_invariants.push_constants: >=256 bytes, matching DXVK MaxTotalPushDataSize adapter acceptance rather than only the 160-byte synthetic layout
hardware_invariants.sampled_image_extent: >=2800x1752 for the Galaxy Tab S8+ native-resolution Tomb Raider target
hardware_invariants.image_format_queries: legacy and Properties2 results must agree field-for-field
hardware_invariants.memory_requirements: size covers the resource, alignment is nonzero and a power of two, and the nonzero type mask contains no unavailable memory type
hardware_invariants.repeatability: repeated requirements and buffer-address queries return the same values
hardware_invariants.dedicated_allocation: both values are Vulkan booleans rather than fixed fake preferences
hardware_invariants.protocol_semantics: return codes, unsupported-shape zeroing, typed same-device ownership, mapping contents, command recording, fences, timelines, lifecycle authentication, and Activity frame-FD topology remain strict

host_branch_proof.reason: deliberately divergent valid values prove that hardware mode executes invariant checks rather than accidentally retaining fake constants

excluded.real_tablet_execution: pending deployment by the integration owner
excluded.visibility: the synthetic Activity sink does not import or display images
excluded.performance: no FPS or speed claim follows from validation-mode work
excluded.synthetic_scale_device: the 59 invented VK_BVB_scale_extension_* success scenario remains strict-fake-only and is not presented as a real Adreno capability

reuse: The required deja query returned no indexed implementation. E070 reuses the existing exact global-dispatch fake contract and the synthetic authenticated Activity harness, preserving both as the strict baseline while adding an explicit client-only hardware-validation branch.
